dialogue: [color=red]Violet Tip #3:[/color] Here's another trick about slide boosting:
after you slide boost, you can carry the momentum a little further by sliding again as you land!
This might not seem like much, but here’s the cool part: [color=red]you can then jump and slide boost again![/color]
SO! Want to fly through the bushes? Slide boost, then boost again.
Chain them together and, yeah, you get the idea!
Once you get it down, it’s the only way you'll want to move around!
Of course, until you slam headfirst into a wall you thought you could clear...
Sometimes, I've found nooks and crannies I’d only reach by chaining a couple slide boosts!
If you’re having trouble with the rhythm, try practicing with these two gaps right next to this sign!
They’re spaced perfectly to slide boost twice in a row!
